```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# copy-folder.sh — Copy a DA site's existing content into a company folder.
#
# The demo rebrands a *copy* of the site's existing Document Authoring (DA)
# content placed under /<companyKey>, leaving the shared original untouched
# (SKILL.md Step 2). This script performs that copy deterministically via the
# DA Admin Copy API — including the 206 / continuation-token paging that a
# hand-rolled curl call almost always forgets, which is how partial copies
# happen.
#
# The DA Copy API is recursive at the folder level: POST /copy/{org}/{repo}/{path}
# with a multipart `destination` field copies the whole subtree under {path}.
# For large trees the API returns 206 with {"continuationToken":...}; you must
# re-POST with that token until it returns 204. This script does that loop.
#
# Usage:
#   .claude/skills/rebrand-portal/scripts/da/copy-folder.sh <org> <repo> <companyKey> [--token-file <path>]
#
#   <org>/<repo>   the DA org and site (same as the GitHub org/repo).
#   <companyKey>   company slug; content lands under /companies/<companyKey>.
#   --token-file   path to the env file holding DA_TOKEN (default: ./token.env
#                  resolved from the repo root).
#
# Reads DA_TOKEN (never printed). Copies ONLY the en/config/public top-level
# trees under /{org}/{repo} (allowlist; override via DA_COPY_ALLOW) into
# /{org}/{repo}/companies/<companyKey>/..., then verifies by a recursive re-list. Sibling
# company demo folders and stray root entries are intentionally NOT copied.
#
# Exit codes: 0 = copied + verified; 1 = usage/auth error; 2 = copy failed;
# 3 = source empty (nothing to copy); 4 = verification mismatch.

set -euo pipefail

ADMIN="${DA_ADMIN_BASE:-https://admin.da.live}"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"

die() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

[ $# -ge 3 ] || die "usage: da-copy-folder.sh <org> <repo> <companyKey> [--token-file <path>]"
ORG="$1"; REPO="$2"; COMPANY="${3#/}"; shift 3

case "$COMPANY" in
  ""|*/*|*..*|.*|*[^a-z0-9-]*)
    die "companyKey must be a lowercase slug like acme-demo (got: $COMPANY)"
    ;;
esac

RESERVED_COMPANY_KEYS="api auth blocks companies config en fonts icons ja media public scripts styles tools"
for key in $RESERVED_COMPANY_KEYS; do
  [ "$COMPANY" = "$key" ] && die "companyKey '$COMPANY' is reserved; use a specific company slug like ${COMPANY}-demo"
done

# Foldered demos live under one container folder so the DA root stays uncluttered:
# /companies/<companyKey>/... rather than N sibling /<companyKey> folders next to the real
# content trees (en, config, public). DEST_ROOT is the single place the container prefix is
# built; everything downstream (copy destination, verify/repair list) derives from it.
CONTAINER="companies"
DEST_ROOT="$CONTAINER/$COMPANY"

STATE_FILE="$ROOT/.internal/onboarding-state.json"
if [ -f "$STATE_FILE" ]; then
  STATE_DA_FOLDER="$(python3 -c '
import json, sys
try:
    state = json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))
except Exception:
    sys.exit(0)
folder = (state.get("customer") or {}).get("daFolder")
if isinstance(folder, str):
    folder = "/" + folder.strip().strip("/")
    if folder != "/":
        print(folder)
' "$STATE_FILE" || true)"
  if [ -n "$STATE_DA_FOLDER" ] && [ "$STATE_DA_FOLDER" != "/$DEST_ROOT" ]; then
    die "companyKey '$COMPANY' -> /$DEST_ROOT does not match state company folder $STATE_DA_FOLDER"
  fi
fi

TOKEN_FILE=""
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --token-file) TOKEN_FILE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    *) die "unknown arg: $1" ;;
  esac
done

if [ -z "$TOKEN_FILE" ]; then
  TOKEN_FILE="$ROOT/token.env"
fi
[ -f "$TOKEN_FILE" ] || die "token file not found: $TOKEN_FILE (create it with DA_TOKEN=...)"
DA_TOKEN="$(grep -E '^DA_TOKEN=' "$TOKEN_FILE" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"'"'"' ' | tr -d '\r')"
[ -n "$DA_TOKEN" ] || die "DA_TOKEN missing/empty in $TOKEN_FILE"

AUTH=(-H "Authorization: ******")

# The demo copies ONLY the three top-level content trees that make up the portal:
#   en      -> the authored pages (incl. nav/footer and reports/my-dam subtrees)
#   config  -> site config, incl. config/access (the access-control .json sheet)
#   public  -> the login/welcome page
# Everything else at the root — sibling company demo folders (e.g. /disney, /urbn),
# stray files, dotfolders — is intentionally NOT copied, so /<company> is a clean,
# faithful mirror of just the portal content. Override with DA_COPY_ALLOW if ever needed.
ALLOW_TOP="${DA_COPY_ALLOW:-en config public}"
is_allowed_top() {
  local name="$1" a
  for a in $ALLOW_TOP; do [ "$name" = "$a" ] && return 0; done
  return 1
}

# list_json <subpath> -> concatenated JSON array of every page of a DA list,
# following the da-continuation-token response header. Fails hard on non-200
# (a 404/403 is NOT "empty" — it is a bad token/path).
list_json() {
  local sub="$1" url="$ADMIN/list/$ORG/$REPO" tok="" hdrs body code combined="[]"
  [ -n "$sub" ] && url="$url/$sub"
  while :; do
    hdrs="$(mktemp)"; body="$(mktemp)"
    code="$(curl -sS "${AUTH[@]}" -D "$hdrs" -o "$body" -w '%{http_code}' \
              ${tok:+-H "da-continuation-token: $tok"} "$url")" || { rm -f "$hdrs" "$body"; die "list request failed for /$ORG/$REPO/$sub"; }
    if [ "$code" != "200" ]; then
      rm -f "$hdrs" "$body"
      die "list returned HTTP $code for /$ORG/$REPO/$sub (404/403 = wrong path or bad/expired DA_TOKEN, NOT empty)"
    fi
    combined="$(python3 - "$combined" "$body" <<'PY'
import json,sys
a=json.loads(sys.argv[1] or "[]")
try: b=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
except Exception: b=[]
print(json.dumps(a+(b if isinstance(b,list) else [])))
PY
)"
    tok="$(grep -i '^da-continuation-token:' "$hdrs" | head -1 | cut -d: -f2- | tr -d ' \r' || true)"
    rm -f "$hdrs" "$body"
    [ -n "$tok" ] || break
  done
  printf '%s' "$combined"
}

# entries: read a list JSON on stdin, emit "TYPE<TAB>relpath" per entry, where
# TYPE is F(ile) or D(irectory) and relpath is under /{org}/{repo}. For files
# the extension is appended so the value is the real document path.
entries() {
  # NOTE: uses python3 -c (not a heredoc) so stdin stays the piped list JSON.
  python3 -c '
import json,sys
org,repo=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2]
try:
    data=json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    data=[]
pref="/%s/%s/"%(org,repo)
for it in data:
    p=it.get("path","") or ""
    rel=p[len(pref):] if p.startswith(pref) else p.lstrip("/")
    if not rel: continue
    ext=it.get("ext")
    print(("F\t%s.%s"%(rel,ext)) if ext else ("D\t%s"%rel))
' "$ORG" "$REPO"
}

# recursive_count <subpath> -> number of file docs under subpath (recursive).
recursive_count() {
  local sub="$1" n=0 typ rel
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r typ rel; do
    [ -z "${typ:-}" ] && continue
    if [ "$typ" = "F" ]; then
      n=$((n+1))
    else
      n=$((n + $(recursive_count "$rel") ))
    fi
  done < <(list_json "$sub" | entries)
  echo "$n"
}

# recursive_files <subpath> -> emit each FILE doc's relpath (under /{org}/{repo})
# beneath subpath, recursively. Used for path-by-path copy verification (a total
# count can hide an entire missing subtree when another subtree over-counts).
recursive_files() {
  local sub="$1" typ rel
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r typ rel; do
    [ -z "${typ:-}" ] && continue
    if [ "$typ" = "F" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$rel"
    else
      recursive_files "$rel"
    fi
  done < <(list_json "$sub" | entries)
}

# copy_entry <relpath> — copy one entry (recursively for folders) into
# /{company}/<relpath>, looping on the 206 continuation token until 204.
copy_entry() {
  local rel="$1" dest="/$ORG/$REPO/$DEST_ROOT/$1" url="$ADMIN/copy/$ORG/$REPO/$1"
  local tok="" code tmp
  while :; do
    tmp="$(mktemp)"
    code="$(curl -sS "${AUTH[@]}" -o "$tmp" -w '%{http_code}' \
             -F "destination=$dest" ${tok:+-F "continuation-token=$tok"} "$url")"
    case "$code" in
      204) rm -f "$tmp"; return 0 ;;
      206) tok="$(python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get("continuationToken",""))' "$tmp")"
           rm -f "$tmp"
           [ -n "$tok" ] || { echo "ERROR: 206 with no continuationToken for $rel" >&2; return 2; } ;;
      *)   rm -f "$tmp"; echo "ERROR: copy of $rel -> $dest returned HTTP $code" >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac
  done
}

echo ">> Enumerating existing content under /$ORG/$REPO ..."
# A failed list (404/403/etc.) MUST abort — it is a bad token/path, NEVER
# grounds to conclude the source is empty. Only a real HTTP 200 with zero
# entries counts as empty.
if ! TOP_JSON="$(list_json "")"; then
  echo "ERROR: could not list /$ORG/$REPO — aborting. This is NOT treated as an empty source; fix DA_TOKEN or the org/repo and retry." >&2
  exit 1
fi
TOP="$(printf '%s' "$TOP_JSON" | entries)"
if [ -z "${TOP//[$'\n\t ']/}" ]; then
  echo ">> Authenticated list of /$ORG/$REPO returned HTTP 200 with ZERO documents — source is genuinely empty; nothing to copy."
  exit 3
fi

echo ">> Copying top-level entries into /$DEST_ROOT ..."
COPIED=0; ELIGIBLE=0
while IFS=$'\t' read -r typ rel; do
  [ -z "${typ:-}" ] && continue
  if ! is_allowed_top "$rel"; then echo "   - skip $rel (only en/config/public are copied)"; continue; fi
  echo "   - copy $rel -> /$DEST_ROOT/$rel"
  copy_entry "$rel"
  COPIED=$((COPIED+1))
  if [ "$typ" = "F" ]; then ELIGIBLE=$((ELIGIBLE+1)); else ELIGIBLE=$((ELIGIBLE + $(recursive_count "$rel") )); fi
done <<< "$TOP"

[ "$COPIED" -gt 0 ] || die "none of the expected top-level trees (en/config/public) were found under /$ORG/$REPO — check the org/repo and DA_TOKEN"

echo ">> Verifying copy under /$DEST_ROOT (path-by-path — every source doc must have a copy) ..."
# Enumerate every eligible SOURCE file relpath (skipping the company folder + dotfolders),
# then assert each one exists under /$DEST_ROOT/<relpath>. A count check is NOT enough: a
# single over-counted subtree (e.g. /en) can mask a whole missing one (e.g. /public or the
# /config folder that carries the access-control sheet) — exactly how the login/welcome
# page and config/access silently went missing before.
SRC_FILES="$(mktemp)"; DST_SET="$(mktemp)"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r typ rel; do
  [ -z "${typ:-}" ] && continue
  is_allowed_top "$rel" || continue
  if [ "$typ" = "F" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$rel" >> "$SRC_FILES"; else recursive_files "$rel" >> "$SRC_FILES"; fi
done <<< "$TOP"

# compute_missing <dst_set_file>: print every source relpath (WITH its extension) that has
# no counterpart in the given destination set. The extension is part of the relpath, so a
# wrong-extension twin (e.g. an .xlsx media asset, or any re-authored file, standing in for
# the real source config/access/application.json DA sheet) is correctly reported MISSING,
# never a false match — faithful extensions are enforced here. In DA a .json is a structured
# sheet (publishes as /<path>.json); an .xlsx is opaque media that never publishes — so the
# extension MUST match the source exactly.
compute_missing() {
  local dst="$1" rel
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [ -z "$rel" ] && continue
    grep -qxF "$rel" "$dst" || printf '%s\n' "$rel"
  done < <(sort -u "$SRC_FILES")
}

# Destination file set, with the leading "$DEST_ROOT/" stripped so paths line up with source.
recursive_files "$DEST_ROOT" | sed "s#^$DEST_ROOT/##" | sort -u > "$DST_SET"

MISS="$(mktemp)"
compute_missing "$DST_SET" > "$MISS"
MISSING="$(grep -c . "$MISS" || true)"

# Repair pass — this is the fix for the "config folder was the miss" failure. If the bulk
# top-level recursive copy left ANY source document without a destination counterpart (the
# /config subtree with its access sheet, a nested page, etc.), copy each missing document
# INDIVIDUALLY from its exact source path. copy_entry copies the real resource, so a .json
# sheet stays .json and a .docx stays .docx — it never re-authors or converts a doc to a
# different type. Only if something is STILL missing after this repair do we fail.
if [ "$MISSING" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo ">> $MISSING document(s) not present after the bulk copy — repairing by copying each one individually ..." >&2
  while IFS= read -r rel; do
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# ensure-eds-tokens.sh — validate DA access and ensure a Helix Admin token.
#
# Usage:
#   .claude/skills/rebrand-portal/scripts/da/ensure-eds-tokens.sh <org> <site> [--token-file token.env]
#
# Reads DA_TOKEN from token.env. Reuses an existing valid HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN when
# present; otherwise mints a new Helix Admin API key from DA_TOKEN and writes it
# back to token.env. Never prints token values.

set -euo pipefail

ADMIN_DA="${DA_ADMIN_BASE:-https://admin.da.live}"
ADMIN_HLX="${HELIX_ADMIN_BASE:-${HLX_ADMIN_BASE:-https://admin.hlx.page}}"

die() {
  echo "ERROR: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

[ $# -ge 2 ] || die "usage: ensure-eds-tokens.sh <org> <site> [--token-file token.env]"
ORG="$1"
SITE="$2"
shift 2

TOKEN_FILE="token.env"
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --token-file)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || die "--token-file requires a path"
      TOKEN_FILE="$2"
      shift 2
      ;;
    *)
      die "unknown arg: $1"
      ;;
  esac
done

[ -f "$TOKEN_FILE" ] || die "token file not found: $TOKEN_FILE"

read_env_value() {
  local key="$1"
  node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const key = process.argv[1];
const file = process.argv[2];
const text = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
const line = text.split(/\\r?\\n/).find((row) => row.match(new RegExp('^\\\\s*' + key + '\\\\s*=')));
if (!line) process.exit(0);
let value = line.slice(line.indexOf('=') + 1).trim();
value = value.replace(/^['\"]|['\"]$/g, '');
value = value.replace(/^Bearer\\s+/i, '');
process.stdout.write(value);
" "$key" "$TOKEN_FILE"
}

write_env_value() {
  local key="$1"
  local value_file="$2"
  node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const key = process.argv[1];
const valueFile = process.argv[2];
const tokenFile = process.argv[3];
const value = fs.readFileSync(valueFile, 'utf8').trim();
let text = fs.readFileSync(tokenFile, 'utf8');
const re = new RegExp('^\\\\s*' + key + '\\\\s*=.*$', 'm');
if (re.test(text)) {
  text = text.replace(re, key + '=' + value);
} else {
  text = text.replace(/\\s*$/, '') + '\\n' + key + '=' + value + '\\n';
}
fs.writeFileSync(tokenFile, text, { mode: 0o600 });
" "$key" "$value_file" "$TOKEN_FILE"
}

DA_TOKEN="$(read_env_value DA_TOKEN)"
[ -n "$DA_TOKEN" ] || die "DA_TOKEN missing/empty in $TOKEN_FILE"

tmp_body="$(mktemp)"
tmp_token="$(mktemp)"
cleanup() {
  rm -f "$tmp_body" "$tmp_token"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

da_code="$(curl -sS -o "$tmp_body" -w '%{http_code}' \
  -H "Authorization: ******" \
  "$ADMIN_DA/list/$ORG/$SITE")" || die "DA_TOKEN is expired or does not have access to this DA site."

if [ "$da_code" != "200" ]; then
  die "DA_TOKEN is expired or does not have access to this DA site. DA list returned HTTP $da_code."
fi

echo "DA_TOKEN verified for $ORG/$SITE."

HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN="$(read_env_value HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN)"
if [ -n "$HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN" ]; then
  hlx_code="$(curl -sS -o "$tmp_body" -w '%{http_code}' \
    -H "x-auth-token: $HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN" \
    "$ADMIN_HLX/status/$ORG/$SITE/main/")" || hlx_code="000"
  if [ "$hlx_code" = "200" ]; then
    echo "Existing HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN verified for $ORG/$SITE."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "Existing HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN did not verify; minting a replacement."
fi

mint_code="$(curl -sS -o "$tmp_body" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: ******" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "description": "rebrand-portal rebrand", "roles": ["admin"] }' \
  "$ADMIN_HLX/config/$ORG/sites/$SITE/apiKeys.json")" || {
    die "DA_TOKEN works for DA, but this user cannot mint the publish token for this site. Use a DA token from a user with required site admin/config rights."
  }

if [ "$mint_code" != "200" ]; then
  die "DA_TOKEN works for DA, but this user cannot mint the publish token for this site. Helix mint returned HTTP $mint_code."
fi

node -e "
const fs = require('fs');
const body = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], 'utf8'));
if (!body.value || typeof body.value !== 'string') process.exit(2);
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], body.value, { mode: 0o600 });
" "$tmp_body" "$tmp_token" || {
  die "DA_TOKEN works for DA, but this user cannot mint the publish token for this site. Helix mint response did not include a token value."
}

write_env_value HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN "$tmp_token"

FINAL_HLX_TOKEN="$(cat "$tmp_token")"
verify_code="$(curl -sS -o "$tmp_body" -w '%{http_code}' \
  -H "x-auth-token: $FINAL_HLX_TOKEN" \
  "$ADMIN_HLX/status/$ORG/$SITE/main/")" || verify_code="000"

if [ "$verify_code" != "200" ]; then
  die "Minted publish token did not verify for this site. Helix status returned HTTP $verify_code."
fi

echo "HLX_ADMIN_TOKEN minted, stored, and verified for $ORG/$SITE."
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * verify.mjs — Step 4g rebrand verification as EXECUTABLE checks, not prose.
 *
 * The 4g doc used to describe these checks in prose the agent could skip or that stated a
 * codebase fact that had drifted from reality (e.g. "the header logo CSS uses max-height"
 * when it was still fixed-width). Each check here reads the ACTUAL tree or live preview and
 * returns a hard pass/fail, using the base brand values captured by capture-base.mjs (from
 * state), never a hardcoded literal.
 *
 *   node .claude/skills/rebrand-portal/scripts/rebrand/verify.mjs \
 *     [--repo-root <dir>] [--preview <host>] [--company <companyKey>] \
 *     [--report <report.json>] [--only <check,check>] [--write-report <path.json>]
 *
 * Tree-only checks (no --preview needed): header-logo, residue, structural-residue,
 *   icon-reference-resolution, welcome-header-home-link, icon-render.
 * Preview checks (need --preview + --company): nav-404-loop, applied-css.
 * Report checks (need --report): stale-card-images, card-count, hero-quality.
 *
 * --write-report writes a JSON report ({ checkedAt, checkedCommit, results }) for
 * whatever ran, so hooks/guard-step5-verify-gate.sh has a structured, staleness-
 * checkable artifact to read instead of re-parsing stderr.
 *
 * Exit 0 = every applicable check passed; 1 = a check FAILED; 2 = usage/setup error.
 */
import {
  readFileSync, existsSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { resolve, join } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { execSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { walk, captureAllBaseHexes } from './fs-walk.mjs';

function resolveRepoRoot(arg) {
  if (arg) return resolve(arg);
  try {
    return execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel', { encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();
  } catch {
    return process.cwd();
  }
}

function loadBaseBrand(repoRoot) {
  const statePath = join(repoRoot, '.internal', 'onboarding-state.json');
  if (!existsSync(statePath)) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(readFileSync(statePath, 'utf8')).baseBrand || null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ---- CHECK: header-logo (tree) --------------------------------------------------
// Two live-shipped failure modes, both caught here by reading the ACTUAL rule:
//   1. Fixed `width` + `height: auto` with no max-height — renders a square-aspect
//      mark far taller than the header, spilling over the hero.
//   2. `width: auto` + `height: auto` (relying only on max-height) — inside the
//      nested inline-flex brand chain (nav-brand > a > span.icon > img) the image
//      has no definite height to resolve against and COLLAPSES to 0×0, so the logo
//      renders invisible (not broken — just gone). The fix that works is an
//      explicit non-auto `height` (e.g. calc(var(--nav-height) - N) or 100%),
//      typically with object-fit:contain. So a brand-logo img/svg rule MUST carry
//      an explicit non-auto height, not height:auto alone.
export function checkHeaderLogo(repoRoot) {
  const cssPath = join(repoRoot, 'blocks', 'header', 'header.css');
  if (!existsSync(cssPath)) return { name: 'header-logo', pass: false, reason: 'blocks/header/header.css not found' };
  const css = readFileSync(cssPath, 'utf8');
  // Extract the two brand-logo rule bodies.
  const targets = [
    /header nav \.nav-brand img\s*\{([^}]*)\}/,
    /header \.nav-brand \.icon img,\s*\n?\s*header \.nav-brand \.icon svg\s*\{([^}]*)\}/,
  ];
  const problems = [];
  for (const re of targets) {
    const m = css.match(re);
    if (!m) continue;
    const body = m[1];
    const hasFixedWidth = /(?:^|[;{\s])width\s*:\s*\d+px/.test(body);
    const hasMaxHeight = /max-height\s*:/.test(body);
    // Does the rule set an explicit, non-auto `height`? (e.g. calc(...), NNpx, 100%)
    const heightDecl = body.match(/(?:^|[;{\s])height\s*:\s*([^;}]+)/);
    const hasExplicitHeight = Boolean(heightDecl) && !/^\s*auto\s*$/i.test(heightDecl[1]);
    if (hasFixedWidth && !hasMaxHeight) {
      problems.push(`a brand-logo rule uses fixed width without max-height:\n${body.trim()}`);
    }
    if (!hasMaxHeight) {
      problems.push('a brand-logo rule has no max-height bound against --nav-height');
    }
    if (!hasExplicitHeight) {
      problems.push(
        'a brand-logo img/svg rule has no explicit non-auto height (height:auto alone '
        + 'collapses to 0×0 in the nested nav-brand flex chain — invisible logo, shipped live)',
      );
    }
  }
  if (problems.length) {
    return {
      name: 'header-logo',
      pass: false,
      reason: `${problems.join('; ')} — fix header.css: width:auto; max-width:<px>; `
        + 'height:calc(var(--nav-height) - N); max-height:calc(var(--nav-height) - N); object-fit:contain',
    };
  }
  return { name: 'header-logo', pass: true, reason: 'brand-logo rules bound by max-height and carry an explicit non-auto height' };
}

// ---- CHECK: residue (tree) ------------------------------------------------------
// Grep the captured old brand hexes + baseSlug across icons/, styles/, blocks/,
// scripts/analytics/. Any hit is un-rebranded residue.

// A hex like #58181D also survives as the decimal rgb() form the browser and
// many hand-authored rules use: `rgb(88 24 29 / 14%)` or `rgb(88, 24, 29)`. The
// plain `#rrggbb` grep misses those entirely (verified live: 15+ decimal-form
// survivors passed a clean residue run). Match both forms.
function hexToRgbTriplet(hex) {
  const m = /^#?([0-9a-f]{6})$/i.exec(hex.trim());
  if (!m) return null;
  const n = m[1];
  return [parseInt(n.slice(0, 2), 16), parseInt(n.slice(2, 4), 16), parseInt(n.slice(4, 6), 16)];
}

// Build a matcher for one old hex that hits `#rrggbb` (any case) and the
// `rgb(r g b …)` / `rgb(r,g,b …)` decimal forms, tolerant of space/comma
// separators and an optional `/ alpha`. Anchored on the three components in
// order so it won't false-hit an unrelated number run.
function oldHexMatchers(hex) {
  const upper = hex.toUpperCase().startsWith('#') ? hex.toUpperCase() : `#${hex.toUpperCase()}`;
  const matchers = [{ label: upper, test: (upperText) => upperText.includes(upper) }];
  const rgb = hexToRgbTriplet(hex);
  if (rgb) {
    const [r, g, b] = rgb;
    const re = new RegExp(`rgba?\\(\\s*${r}\\s*[ ,]\\s*${g}\\s*[ ,]\\s*${b}\\b`, 'i');
    matchers.push({ label: `rgb(${r} ${g} ${b})`, test: (_u, rawText) => re.test(rawText) });
  }
  return matchers;
}

export function checkResidue(repoRoot, baseBrand) {
  if (!baseBrand) return { name: 'residue', pass: false, reason: 'no baseBrand in state — run capture-base.mjs first' };
  const dirs = ['icons', 'styles', 'blocks', join('scripts', 'analytics')].map((d) => join(repoRoot, d));
  const files = dirs.flatMap((d) => walk(d, ['.css', '.svg', '.js', '.scss']));
  const matchers = (baseBrand.oldHexes || []).flatMap((h) => oldHexMatchers(h));
  const slug = baseBrand.baseSlug;
  const hits = [];
  for (const f of files) {
    const text = readFileSync(f, 'utf8');
    const upper = text.toUpperCase();
    for (const m of matchers) {
      if (m.test(upper, text)) hits.push(`${f}: old hex ${m.label}`);
    }
    // Strip the infra deploy host (e.g. 'frescopamedia.com') before the slug test —
    // it's the production domain baked into every checkout, not customer brand residue.
    const slugTestText = text.replace(/frescopamedia(?:\.com)?/gi, '');
    if (slug && new RegExp(slug, 'i').test(slugTestText)) hits.push(`${f}: baseSlug '${slug}'`);
  }
  if (hits.length) {
    return { name: 'residue', pass: false, reason: `${hits.length} residue hit(s):\n  ${hits.slice(0, 40).join('\n  ')}` };
  }
  return { name: 'residue', pass: true, reason: `no old-brand hex/slug (incl. rgb() form) in ${files.length} files` };
}

// ---- CHECK: structural-residue (tree) -------------------------------------------
// checkResidue only catches the 11 named :root tokens. capture-base.mjs also
// captures EVERY hex literal repo-wide (baseBrand.allBaseHexes), tagged by
// file+selector. Comparing "is this hex unchanged" across the WHOLE repo is
// too broad on its own — most of the repo's hexes are neutral UI chrome
// (#1E1E1E strokes, #707070/#333 greys, pure #FFF) that legitimately never
// change on any rebrand, and flagging all of them would flood every run with
// noise no agent could act on. So this check narrows the comparison to
// BRAND-ADJACENT FILES ONLY: a file qualifies if it contains at least one hex
// from baseBrand.oldHexes (the 11 named brand tokens) in EITHER the pre-capture
// baseline or the current tree — i.e. a file already known to carry brand
// color at all. Within a qualifying file, any hex that is byte-identical to
// the pre-capture baseline AT THE SAME selector is residue. This is exactly
// the Woolworths case: theme.css carries #00647D/#004d61 (named brand tokens,
// qualifying the file) alongside #003d4d (a one-off literal, never a named
// token, invisible to checkResidue) — once the file qualifies, #003d4d
// surviving unchanged is now caught.
function loadSemanticAllowlist(repoRoot) {
  const p = join(repoRoot, '.claude', 'skills', 'rebrand-portal', 'scripts', 'rebrand', 'semantic-color-allowlist.json');
  if (!existsSync(p)) return { selectorPatterns: [], filePatterns: [] };
  try {
    const raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
    return {
      selectorPatterns: (raw.selectorPatterns || []).map((s) => new RegExp(s, 'i')),
      filePatterns: (raw.filePatterns || []).map((s) => new RegExp(s, 'i')),
    };
  } catch {
    return { selectorPatterns: [], filePatterns: [] };
  }
}

function isAllowlisted(allowlist, file, selector) {
  if (allowlist.filePatterns.some((re) => re.test(file))) return true;
  if (selector && allowlist.selectorPatterns.some((re) => re.test(selector))) return true;
  return false;
}

export function checkStructuralResidue(repoRoot, baseBrand) {
  if (!baseBrand) {
    return { name: 'structural-residue', pass: false, reason: 'no baseBrand in state — run capture-base.mjs first' };
  }
  const baseline = baseBrand.allBaseHexes;
  if (!Array.isArray(baseline)) {
    return {
      name: 'structural-residue',
      pass: false,
      reason: 'no baseBrand.allBaseHexes in state — re-run capture-base.mjs (needs the repo-wide hex capture)',
    };
  }
  const namedBrandHexes = new Set((baseBrand.oldHexes || []).map((h) => h.toUpperCase()));
  if (namedBrandHexes.size === 0) {
    return {
      name: 'structural-residue',
      pass: false,
      reason: 'baseBrand.oldHexes is empty — cannot determine which files are brand-adjacent',
    };
  }
  const allowlist = loadSemanticAllowlist(repoRoot);
  const current = captureAllBaseHexes(repoRoot);

  // A file "qualifies" (is brand-adjacent) if it carries at least one named
  // brand hex, in either the baseline or the current tree.
  const qualifyingFiles = new Set();
  for (const entry of baseline) if (namedBrandHexes.has(entry.hex)) qualifyingFiles.add(entry.file);
  for (const entry of current) if (namedBrandHexes.has(entry.hex)) qualifyingFiles.add(entry.file);

  // Index the pre-capture baseline by "file::selector" -> Set(hex) for O(1) lookup.
  const byKey = new Map();
  for (const entry of baseline) {
    const key = `${entry.file}::${entry.selector || ''}`;
    if (!byKey.has(key)) byKey.set(key, new Set());
    byKey.get(key).add(entry.hex);
  }
  const hits = [];
  for (const entry of current) {
    if (!qualifyingFiles.has(entry.file)) continue;
    if (isAllowlisted(allowlist, entry.file, entry.selector)) continue;
    const key = `${entry.file}::${entry.selector || ''}`;
    const wasHere = byKey.get(key);
    if (wasHere && wasHere.has(entry.hex)) {
      hits.push(`${entry.file} (${entry.selector || 'top-level'}): unchanged old-brand hex ${entry.hex}`);
    }
  }
  if (hits.length) {
    return {
      name: 'structural-residue',
      pass: false,
      reason: `${hits.length} structural residue hit(s) in ${qualifyingFiles.size} brand-adjacent file(s) — a hex `
        + `at this file+selector matches the pre-rebrand baseline exactly and was never `
        + `changed:\n  ${hits.slice(0, 40).join('\n  ')}`,
    };
  }
  return {
    name: 'structural-residue',
    pass: true,
    reason: `no unchanged old-brand hex at any pre-captured file+selector across ${qualifyingFiles.size} brand-adjacent file(s)`,
  };
}
```

### `bash`

**Fetch DA company source files locally**

$ cd /Users/mohitar/Documents/code/eds/master_1/prod/assethub-spark.worktrees/demo-kirklands && mkdir -p .internal/da-src && TOKEN=$(node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('token.env','utf8').split(/\r?\n/).find(l=>l.startsWith('DA_TOKEN=')); if(t) process.stdout.write(t.slice('DA_TOKEN='.length).trim().replace(/^Bearer\s+/i,''));") && TOKEN="$TOKEN" node - <<'NODE'
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');
const https = require('https');
const token = process.env.TOKEN;
const repo = 'aem-showcase/assethub-spark';
const outDir = '.internal/da-src';
function get(url) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = https.get(url, { headers: { Authorization: token } }, (res) => {
      let data='';
      res.setEncoding('utf8');
      res.on('data', (d) => data += d);
      res.on('end', () => {
        if (res.statusCode >= 200 && res.statusCode < 300) resolve({ status: res.statusCode, data, headers: res.headers });
        else reject(new Error(`${res.statusCode} ${url}`));
      });
    });
    req.on('error', reject);
  });
}
async function listRecursive(subpath, acc=[]) {
  const { data } = await get(`https://admin.da.live/list/${repo}/${subpath}`);
  const entries = JSON.parse(data);
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const rel = entry.path.replace(`/${repo}/`, '');
    if (entry.ext) acc.push(rel);
    else await listRecursive(rel, acc);
  }
  return acc;
}
(async () => {
  const files = await listRecursive('companies/kirklands');
  files.sort();
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(outDir, 'manifest.json'), JSON.stringify(files, null, 2));
  for (const rel of files) {
    const { data } = await get(`https://admin.da.live/source/${repo}/${rel}`);
    const dest = path.join(outDir, rel);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(dest, data);
  }
  console.log(`fetched ${files.length} files`);
})();
NODE

from PIL import Image
for name in ['seasonal-hero.webp','seasonal-everyday.webp']:
    img=Image.open('.internal/tmp/'+name).convert('RGBA').resize((128,128))
    colors=img.getcolors(128*128)
    colors=[(c,rgba) for c,rgba in colors if rgba[3]>0]
    colors.sort(reverse=True)
    print(name)
    seen=0
    for count,rgba in colors[:20]:
        hex='#%02X%02X%02X' % rgba[:3]
        print(count, hex, rgba)
        seen+=1
        if seen>=12: break
PY

from pathlib import Path
import base64
from PIL import Image

root = Path('.')
logo_svg = (root / '.internal/tmp/kirklands-logo.svg').read_text()
favicon_png = root / '.internal/tmp/kirklands-favicon.png'
hero_palette = {
    'surface': '#E8E8E4',
    'text': '#212322',
    'dark': '#231F20',
    'primary': '#00253D',
    'primary_hover': '#262837',
    'secondary': '#BFA072',
    'accent_secondary': '#BFA487',
    'accent_tertiary': '#828081',
    'welcome_bg': '#231F20',
    'welcome_rgb': '191 160 114',
    'neutral_50': '#FFFFFF',
    'neutral_100': '#F7F7F5',
    'neutral_200': '#ECECE8',
    'neutral_300': '#D9D8D4',
    'neutral_400': '#C2C0BA',
    'neutral_500': '#AAA8A2',
    'neutral_600': '#828081',
    'neutral_700': '#5E5C5D',
    'neutral_800': '#3A3637',
    'neutral_900': '#212322',
}

# icons
icons = root / 'icons'
icons.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(icons / 'kirklands-icon.svg').write_text(logo_svg)
# square mark sourced from the site's real favicon
png64 = base64.b64encode(favicon_png.read_bytes()).decode('ascii')
beans_svg = f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 512 512" role="img" aria-label="Kirkland's mark">
  <rect width="512" height="512" rx="96" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <image href="data:image/png;base64,{png64}" x="56" y="56" width="400" height="400" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"/>
</svg>
'''
(icons / 'kirklands-beans.svg').write_text(beans_svg)
(root / 'favicon.svg').write_text(beans_svg)
img = Image.open(favicon_png).convert('RGBA')
img.save(root / 'favicon.ico', sizes=[(64,64), (48,48), (32,32), (16,16)])
# overwrite old brand-specific SVG assets to eliminate residue if referenced anywhere
for legacy in ['frescopa-icon.svg', 'frescopa_logo.svg']:
    (icons / legacy).write_text(logo_svg)
for legacy in ['frescopa-beans.svg']:
    (icons / legacy).write_text(beans_svg)
chevron = '''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#231F20" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>\n'''
(icons / 'chevron-down.svg').write_text(chevron)

# broad color swaps in brand-adjacent areas
color_map = {
    '#F4E9DC': hero_palette['surface'],
    '#00647D': hero_palette['primary'],
    '#004D61': hero_palette['primary_hover'],
    '#004d61': hero_palette['primary_hover'],
    '#95351D': hero_palette['secondary'],
    '#58181D': hero_palette['text'],
    '#DC6E52': hero_palette['accent_secondary'],
    '#EBA439': hero_palette['accent_tertiary'],
    '#2F2318': hero_palette['welcome_bg'],
    '#eaa33a': hero_palette['secondary'].lower(),
}
for folder in [root / 'icons', root / 'styles', root / 'blocks', root / 'scripts' / 'analytics']:
    if not folder.exists():
        continue
    for path in folder.rglob('*'):
        if path.suffix.lower() not in {'.svg', '.css', '.js', '.scss'}:
            continue
        text = path.read_text()
        orig = text
        for old, new in color_map.items():
            text = text.replace(old, new)
        if path.suffix.lower() == '.css' or path.suffix.lower() == '.js':
            text = text.replace('frescopa', 'kirklands')

```
/* Restore focus ring on high-contrast mode */
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid Highlight;
    box-shadow: none;
  }
}

/* ================================================================ */

/* Welcome / Sign-In Page — Split-Screen Layout                     */

/* ================================================================ */

/* Prevent flash: match the dark left panel colour from first paint */
body:has(.section.welcome) {
  /* Welcome/login split-screen brand panel is themeable via these tokens (kirklands defaults);
     a company demo overrides --welcome-panel-* + --welcome-tagline to rebrand the login. */
  background-color: var(--welcome-panel-bg, #2f2318);
  overflow: hidden;
}

/* Hide the slim nav bar — branding lives in the left brand panel */
body:has(.section.welcome) > header {
  display: none;
}

/* Hide footer for a focused sign-in experience */
body:has(.section.welcome) > footer {
  display: none;
}

/* Full-viewport two-column split */
body:has(.section.welcome) > main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 55% 45%;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  padding: 0;
  position: relative;
  align-items: stretch;
}

/* ── Left: Brand Panel ────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Dark brand background with the gold beans icon as a large decorative mark */
body:has(.section.welcome) > main::before {
  content: '';
  background-color: var(--welcome-panel-bg, #2f2318);
  background-image:
    radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 15% 110%, rgb(var(--welcome-panel-accent-rgb, 234 163 58) / 22%) 0%, transparent 100%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 45% at 90% -5%,  rgb(var(--welcome-panel-accent-rgb, 234 163 58) / 10%) 0%, transparent 100%),
    var(--welcome-panel-mark-image, url('/icons/kirklands-beans.svg'));
  background-repeat: no-repeat, no-repeat, no-repeat;
  background-size: cover, cover, 42%;
  background-position: bottom left, top right, center 40%;
}

/* Tagline + brand label stacked at the bottom of the brand panel.
   Split into two line custom properties (--welcome-tagline-line1/-line2) instead of one
   string with a literal \A line-break escape: \A only renders as a line break when it's
   parsed directly in a stylesheet content string — once it's stored inside a custom
   property's value and substituted via var(), it's carried as literal text instead, so a
   company override that sets a one-property tagline with \A in it silently fails to break
   the line. Keeping the \A here, outside any custom property, avoids that class of bug
   regardless of what a per-company override sets each line to. */
body:has(.section.welcome) > main::after {
  content: var(--welcome-tagline-line1, '"The world\'s finest brand,') "\A" var(--welcome-tagline-line2, 'at your fingertips."');
  white-space: pre;
  font-family: var(--heading-font-family);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-style: italic;
  line-height: 1.6;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  color: rgb(255 255 255 / 70%);
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 48px;
  left: 0;
  width: 55%;
  text-align: center;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* ── Right: Auth Panel ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.section.welcome {
  background-color: var(--light-color);
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  margin: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  min-height: 100dvh;
  padding: 0 72px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: flex-start;
  text-align: left;
}

.section.welcome > .default-content-wrapper {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  max-width: 380px;
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
}

/* Brand mark — larger on the auth panel. Brand-agnostic: targets any icon shortcode the
   welcome doc carries (e.g. :kirklands-beans:, :<company>-beans:) so a rebrand needs no CSS edit. */
.section.welcome p:has(.icon) {
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-medium);
  max-width: none;
}

.section.welcome p .icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
}

.section.welcome p .icon img,
.section.welcome p .icon svg {
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
}

.section.welcome h1 {
  font-family: var(--heading-font-family);
  font-size: var(--heading-font-size-l);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--text-color);
  margin: 0 0 var(--spacing-small);
  padding: 0;
  text-align: left;
}

.section.welcome p {
  font-family: var(--body-font-family);
```

const fs = require('fs');

const everydayImg = 'https://kirklands.com/assets/images/seasonal-everyday-hero.webp';

const categoryContract = [
  { slug: 'seasonal-decor', label: 'Seasonal Decor', evidence: 'Main nav label “Seasonal” on https://kirklands.com/ and the Seasonal landing hero on /seasonal/.', sourceUrl: 'https://kirklands.com/seasonal/' },
  { slug: 'halloween', label: 'Halloween', evidence: 'Seasonal page collection tile heading “Halloween”.', sourceUrl: 'https://kirklands.com/seasonal/' },
  { slug: 'football', label: 'Football Hosting', evidence: 'Seasonal page collection tile heading “Football”.', sourceUrl: 'https://kirklands.com/seasonal/' },
  { slug: 'christmas', label: 'Christmas Sneak Peek', evidence: 'Seasonal page collection tile heading “Christmas Sneak Peek”.', sourceUrl: 'https://kirklands.com/seasonal/' },
  { slug: 'everyday-classics', label: 'Everyday Classics', evidence: 'Seasonal page hero region heading “Everyday Classics”.', sourceUrl: 'https://kirklands.com/seasonal/' },
];
fs.writeFileSync('.internal/kirklands-category-contract.json', JSON.stringify(categoryContract, null, 2));

function read(rel) { return fs.readFileSync(path.join(base, rel), 'utf8'); }
function write(rel, text) { fs.writeFileSync(path.join(base, rel), text); }
function facetLink(slug, extras = '') {
  const filters = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({ productCategory: { [slug]: true } }));
  const joiner = extras ? `${extras}&` : '';
  return `${companyBase}/en/search?${joiner}facetFilters=${filters}`;
}
function channelFacetLink(slug, channel) {
  const filters = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({ productCategory: { [slug]: true }, channel: { [channel]: true } }));
  return `${companyBase}/en/search?sortType=topResults&sortDirection=descending&facetFilters=${filters}`;
}
function globalize(html) {
  return html
    .replace(/:frescopa-icon:/g, ':kirklands-icon:')
    .replace(/:frescopa-beans:/g, ':kirklands-beans:')
    .replace(/Fréscopa/g, "Kirkland's")
    .replace(/Frescopa/g, "Kirkland's")
    .replace(/file:\/\/\/\/auth\/login/g, '/auth/login')
    .replace(/file:\/\/\/\//g, '/')
    .replace(/href="\/auth\/login"/g, 'href="/auth/login"')
    .replace(/href="\/en\//g, `href="${companyBase}/en/`)
    .replace(/href="en\//g, `href="${companyBase}/en/`)
    .replace(/href="\/public\//g, `href="${companyBase}/public/`)
    .replace(/srcset="https:\/\/content\.da\.live\/aem-showcase\/assethub-spark\/en\//g, `srcset="https://content.da.live/aem-showcase/assethub-spark/companies/kirklands/en/`)
    .replace(/src="https:\/\/content\.da\.live\/aem-showcase\/assethub-spark\/en\//g, `src="https://content.da.live/aem-showcase/assethub-spark/companies/kirklands/en/`)
    .replace(/Search, preview, and download brand-approved coffee, machine, and lifestyle imagery\./g, 'Search, preview, and download approved seasonal, store, and merchandising imagery.')
    .replace(/Search, browse, and download Kirkland's brand assets\./g, 'Search, browse, and download Kirkland\'s seasonal and store-ready assets.')
    .replace(/assets@frescopa\.coffee/g, 'kirklandssupport@bedbathandbeyond.com');
}

const nav = `<body>\n  <header></header>\n  <main><div><p><a href="${companyBase}/en/">:kirklands-icon:</a></p><div class="section-metadata"><div><div><p>role</p></div><div><p>brand</p></div></div></div><div class="section-metadata"><div><div><p>role</p></div><div><p>tools</p></div></div></div></div></main>\n  <footer></footer>\n</body>\n`;
write('en/nav.html', nav);
write('en/drafts/pkoch/nav.html', nav);

const footer = `<body>\n  <header></header>\n  <main><div><p>:kirklands-icon:</p><p>Bring home the joy with seasonal décor, store-ready photography, and campaign assets for Kirkland's teams.</p><p>Your Kirkland's asset distribution portal.</p><div class="columns"><div><div><p><strong>Company</strong> <br><a href="${companyBase}/en/about">About</a> <br><a href="https://kirklands.com/store-locator/">Store Locator</a> <br><a href="mailto:kirklandssupport@bedbathandbeyond.com">Contact</a></p></div><div><p><strong>Resources</strong> <br><a href="${facetLink('seasonal-decor')}">Seasonal Collections</a> <br><a href="https://kirklands.com/learnmore/">Learn More</a> <br><a href="mailto:kirklandssupport@bedbathandbeyond.com">Support</a></p></div><div></div></div></div><p>© 2026 Kirkland's Home, Inc. All rights reserved.</p></div></main>\n  <footer></footer>\n</body>\n`;
write('en/footer.html', footer);
write('en/drafts/pkoch/footer.html', footer);

function walk(dir) {
  for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(full);
    else if (entry.name.endsWith('.html')) {
      const rel = path.relative(base, full);
      let html = fs.readFileSync(full, 'utf8');
      html = globalize(html);
      html = html.replace(/href="https:\/\/www\.kirklands\.com\/store-locator\//g, 'href="https://kirklands.com/store-locator/');
      fs.writeFileSync(full, html);
    }
  }
}
walk(base);

```
main > .section.hero-container {
  margin: 0;
}

.hero-container .hero-wrapper {
  max-width: unset;
  padding: 0 0 40px;
  margin: 0 0 40px;
}

.hero {
  --hero-image-bleed: 150px;

  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: clamp(560px, 72vh, 760px);
  border-radius: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0;
  background-color: var(--dark-color);
  color: #f5ede0;
}

.hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 1;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      rgb(20 13 8 / 88%) 0%,
      rgb(24 16 10 / 72%) 30%,
      rgb(29 20 12 / 40%) 54%,
      rgb(29 20 12 / 0%) 72%
    ),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(30 21 13 / 8%) 0%, rgb(30 21 13 / 36%) 100%);
}

.hero > div {
  max-width: var(--site-width);
  width: 100%;
  margin: auto;
  padding: 0 var(--spacing-medium);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

@media (width >= 900px) {
  .hero > div {
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-big);
  }
}

.hero > div > div {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 14px;
}

.hero > div > div > p:not(:first-child) {
  margin: 0;
  max-width: 43ch;
  color: rgb(247 237 224 / 90%);
  text-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgb(0 0 0 / 22%);
  font-size: 22px;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.hero > div > div > p:first-child {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero > div > div picture {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 0;
  inset: 0 calc(var(--hero-image-bleed) * -1);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.hero > div > div picture img {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 0;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center right;
  filter: saturate(86%) contrast(102%);
}

.hero > div > div > *:not(p:first-child) {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
}

.hero h3,
.hero h4,
.hero h5,
.hero h6 {
  margin: 0;
  color: rgb(255 248 237 / 88%);
  font: normal normal 200 20px / 1.2 var(--type-base-font-family);
  letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.hero h1,
.hero h2 {
  margin: 0;
  color: #f7efe3;
```

```
.carousel .carousel-slides-container {
    position: relative;
    padding: 0 8px; /* Small padding to ensure cards don't touch edges */
}

.carousel .carousel-slides,
.carousel .carousel-slide-indicators {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.carousel .carousel-slides {
    display: flex;
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    scroll-snap-type: x mandatory;
    overflow: scroll clip;
    gap: 16px;
}

.carousel .carousel-slides::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

.carousel .carousel-slide {
    flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 48px) / 4); /* 4 slides per row */
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    background-color: white;
    border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.carousel .carousel-slide:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 15%);
}

.carousel .carousel-slide:hover .carousel-slide-content {
    background: white; /* White background on hover */
    color: var(--primary-color); /* Red text color on hover */
}

.carousel .carousel-slide:has(.carousel-slide-content[data-align='center']),
.carousel .carousel-slide:has(.carousel-slide-content[data-align='right']) {
    align-items: stretch;
}

/* Image styling - at top of card */
.carousel .carousel-slide .carousel-slide-image {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #f5f5f5; /* Light background for image area */
}

.carousel .carousel-slide .carousel-slide-image picture {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.carousel .carousel-slide .carousel-slide-image picture > img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover; /* Cover the image area */
    transition: transform 0.3s ease; /* Smooth zoom transition */
}

.carousel .carousel-slide:hover .carousel-slide-image picture > img {
    transform: scale(1.05); /* Slightly zoom in image on hover */
}

/* Remove overlay */
.carousel .carousel-slide::after {
    display: none;
}

/* Content styling - black background at bottom */
.carousel .carousel-slide .carousel-slide-content {
    position: relative;
    background: black;
    color: white; /* White text */
    padding: 16px 20px; /* Comfortable padding */
    margin: 0;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 60px; /* Minimum height for title area */
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom-left-radius: 8px;
    border-bottom-right-radius: 8px;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; /* Smooth transitions */
    flex-grow: 1; /* Allow content to grow and fill available space */
}

.carousel .carousel-slide-indicators {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 20px;
    background-color: transparent;
    line-height: 0;
}

.carousel .carousel-slide-indicator button {
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #dadada;
    transition: background-color 0.2s;
```

```
  --status-in-progress: var(--accent-tertiary);
  --status-in-progress-bg: rgb(235 164 57 / 12%);
  --status-completed: #7fb078;
  --status-completed-bg: rgb(127 176 120 / 12%);
  --status-cancelled: var(--color-red);
  --status-cancelled-bg: rgb(163 53 50 / 12%);

  /* focus ring */
  --focus-ring-color: var(--primary-color);
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-ring-color);

  /* semantic action colors */
  --color-destructive: var(--color-red);
  --color-destructive-hover: var(--color-dark-red);
  --color-error: var(--color-red);
  --icon-color: var(--dark-color);
  --icon-color-active: var(--primary-color);

  /* clearance colors */
  --clearance-available: #7fb078;
  --clearance-not-available: var(--color-red);
  --clearance-exceptions: var(--accent-tertiary);
  --clearance-partial: var(--accent-secondary);

  /* action button colors */
  --button-primary: var(--primary-color);
  --button-primary-hover: #004d61;

  /* label colors */
  --label-color: var(--text-color);
  --label-secondary: var(--color-neutral-600);

  /* search UI typography tokens */
  --font-size-00: 10px;
  --font-size-01: 12px;
  --font-size-02: 14px;
  --font-size-03: 16px;
  --font-size-04: 18px;
  --font-size-05: 22px;
  --font-size-06: 28px;
  --line-height-01: 1.2;
  --line-height-02: 1.3;
  --line-height-03: 1.4;
  --line-height-04: 1.5;
  --line-height-05: 1.6;
  --line-height-06: 1.25;
  --line-height-07: 1.1;
}

/* fallback fonts */
@font-face {
  font-family: roboto-condensed-fallback;
  size-adjust: 88.82%;
  src: local('Arial');
}

@font-face {
  font-family: roboto-fallback;
  size-adjust: 99.529%;
  src: local('Arial');
}

html {
  font-size: 62.5%;
}

/* Search blocks use rem; restore 16px root on search pages only */
html:has(.search-results),
html:has(.search-collection-results-wrapper),
html:has(.my-notifications),
html:has(.report-asset-activity),
html:has(.report-searches) {
  font-size: 100%;
}
```

```
/* Search bar sits transparently on the beige hero */
main .section.search-hero .search-bar-wrapper {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

main .section.search-hero .query-input-container {
  background: transparent;
  min-height: unset;
  padding: 0;
}

main .section.search-hero .query-input-bar {
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgb(88 24 29 / 14%);
}

/* Landing: Browse-by-category tiles */
main .section.category-tiles {
  padding: 56px 72px 40px;
  background: rgb(235 164 57 / 8%); /* --accent-tertiary tint, for section-to-section color rhythm */
  text-align: center;
}

main .section.category-tiles > div {
  max-width: var(--site-width);
}

main .section.category-tiles h2 {
  margin: 0 0 28px;
  font-family: var(--heading-font-family);
  color: var(--text-color);
  font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 2.6vw, 2.1rem);
}

/* "search-hero" and "category-tiles" are two styles on ONE combined
   section (see Section Metadata), not two separate stacked sections —
   padding on .section can't create a gap between content that's inside
   the same box. The real separation has to come from margin on the
   first heading in the section (the one right after the search bar),
   targeted via :first-of-type since the exact wrapper-div nesting around
   the search-bar block isn't reliable to select through. */
main .section.category-tiles h2:first-of-type {
  margin-top: 72px;
}

main .section.category-tiles .cards > ul {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 224px));
  justify-content: center;
}

main .section.category-tiles .cards > ul > li {
  height: auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  text-align: left;
  background: var(--color-neutral-50);
  border: 1px solid rgb(88 24 29 / 8%);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgb(88 24 29 / 8%);
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

main .section.category-tiles .cards > ul > li:hover {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgb(88 24 29 / 12%);
}

/* Text-only tile (no image cell) collapses to its body — never reserve a blank
   image band that reads as a broken/unfinished card (see cards.js .no-image). */
main .section.category-tiles .cards > ul > li.no-image {
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

main .section.category-tiles .cards > ul > li.no-image .cards-card-body {
```

```
// file+selector. Comparing "is this hex unchanged" across the WHOLE repo is
// too broad on its own — most of the repo's hexes are neutral UI chrome
// (#1E1E1E strokes, #707070/#333 greys, pure #FFF) that legitimately never
// change on any rebrand, and flagging all of them would flood every run with
// noise no agent could act on. So this check narrows the comparison to
// BRAND-ADJACENT FILES ONLY: a file qualifies if it contains at least one hex
// from baseBrand.oldHexes (the 11 named brand tokens) in EITHER the pre-capture
// baseline or the current tree — i.e. a file already known to carry brand
// color at all. Within a qualifying file, any hex that is byte-identical to
// the pre-capture baseline AT THE SAME selector is residue. This is exactly
// the Woolworths case: theme.css carries #00647D/#004d61 (named brand tokens,
// qualifying the file) alongside #003d4d (a one-off literal, never a named
// token, invisible to checkResidue) — once the file qualifies, #003d4d
// surviving unchanged is now caught.
function loadSemanticAllowlist(repoRoot) {
  const p = join(repoRoot, '.claude', 'skills', 'rebrand-portal', 'scripts', 'rebrand', 'semantic-color-allowlist.json');
  if (!existsSync(p)) return { selectorPatterns: [], filePatterns: [] };
  try {
    const raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'));
    return {
      selectorPatterns: (raw.selectorPatterns || []).map((s) => new RegExp(s, 'i')),
      filePatterns: (raw.filePatterns || []).map((s) => new RegExp(s, 'i')),
    };
  } catch {
    return { selectorPatterns: [], filePatterns: [] };
  }
}

function isAllowlisted(allowlist, file, selector) {
  if (allowlist.filePatterns.some((re) => re.test(file))) return true;
  if (selector && allowlist.selectorPatterns.some((re) => re.test(selector))) return true;
  return false;
}

export function checkStructuralResidue(repoRoot, baseBrand) {
  if (!baseBrand) {
    return { name: 'structural-residue', pass: false, reason: 'no baseBrand in state — run capture-base.mjs first' };
  }
  const baseline = baseBrand.allBaseHexes;
  if (!Array.isArray(baseline)) {
    return {
      name: 'structural-residue',
      pass: false,
      reason: 'no baseBrand.allBaseHexes in state — re-run capture-base.mjs (needs the repo-wide hex capture)',
    };
  }
  const namedBrandHexes = new Set((baseBrand.oldHexes || []).map((h) => h.toUpperCase()));
  if (namedBrandHexes.size === 0) {
    return {
      name: 'structural-residue',
      pass: false,
      reason: 'baseBrand.oldHexes is empty — cannot determine which files are brand-adjacent',
    };
  }
  const allowlist = loadSemanticAllowlist(repoRoot);
  const current = captureAllBaseHexes(repoRoot);

  // A file "qualifies" (is brand-adjacent) if it carries at least one named
  // brand hex, in either the baseline or the current tree.
  const qualifyingFiles = new Set();
  for (const entry of baseline) if (namedBrandHexes.has(entry.hex)) qualifyingFiles.add(entry.file);
  for (const entry of current) if (namedBrandHexes.has(entry.hex)) qualifyingFiles.add(entry.file);

  // Index the pre-capture baseline by "file::selector" -> Set(hex) for O(1) lookup.
  const byKey = new Map();
  for (const entry of baseline) {
    const key = `${entry.file}::${entry.selector || ''}`;
    if (!byKey.has(key)) byKey.set(key, new Set());
    byKey.get(key).add(entry.hex);
  }
  const hits = [];
  for (const entry of current) {
    if (!qualifyingFiles.has(entry.file)) continue;
    if (isAllowlisted(allowlist, entry.file, entry.selector)) continue;
    const key = `${entry.file}::${entry.selector || ''}`;
    const wasHere = byKey.get(key);
    if (wasHere && wasHere.has(entry.hex)) {
      hits.push(`${entry.file} (${entry.selector || 'top-level'}): unchanged old-brand hex ${entry.hex}`);
    }
  }
  if (hits.length) {
    return {
      name: 'structural-residue',
      pass: false,
      reason: `${hits.length} structural residue hit(s) in ${qualifyingFiles.size} brand-adjacent file(s) — a hex `
        + `at this file+selector matches the pre-rebrand baseline exactly and was never `
        + `changed:\n  ${hits.slice(0, 40).join('\n  ')}`,
    };
  }
  return {
    name: 'structural-residue',
    pass: true,
    reason: `no unchanged old-brand hex at any pre-captured file+selector across ${qualifyingFiles.size} brand-adjacent file(s)`,
  };
}
```

```
.cards > ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); /* 4 columns */
  grid-gap: 24px;
}

.cards > ul > li {
  background-color: var(--background-color);
  border-radius: 12px;
  overflow: hidden;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  box-shadow: var(--shape-shadow-card);
  height: 120px;
}

.cards > ul > li:hover {
  /* No visual effects on hover for the card */
}

.cards > ul > li:hover .cards-card-body {
  background-color: white;
}

.cards .cards-card-body {
  flex: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  background-color: var(--light-color);
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
  padding: 16px;
  padding-top: 20px;
}

.cards h2 {
  font-family: var(--heading-font-family);

}

.cards a:hover {

.cards .cards-card-image {

}

.cards > ul > li img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%; /* Make image fill the full height of the card */
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  object-fit: cover;
}

/* Responsive: Adjust for smaller screens */
@media (width < 1200px) {
  .cards > ul {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); /* 2 columns on medium screens */
  }
}

@media (width < 600px) {
  .cards > ul {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr; /* 1 column on mobile */
  }

  .cards > ul > li {
    flex-direction: column; /* Stack vertically on mobile */
    height: auto; /* Allow height to adjust on mobile */
  }

  .cards .cards-card-image {
    flex: none; /* Reset flex on mobile */
  }

  .cards > ul > li img {
    height: auto; /* Reset height on mobile */
  }
}

/* Two-up variant: 2-column grid for sections with fewer cards */
.cards.two-up > ul {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
}

/* Three-up variant: 3-column grid */
.cards.three-up > ul {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
}

@media (width < 600px) {
  .cards.two-up > ul,
  .cards.three-up > ul {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

/* Highlights variant styling */
.cards.highlights > ul > li {
  background-color: var(--dark-color);
  color: white;
  position: relative;
  flex-direction: column; /* Stack image on top, text at bottom */
  height: 218px; /* Fixed height */
  border-radius: 8px; /* Smaller border radius for highlights */
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease; /* Smooth background transition */
}

.cards.highlights > ul > li:hover {
  background-color: var(--primary-color);
}

.cards.highlights .cards-card-body {
  width: 100%; /* Full width */
  padding: 12px; /* Remove vertical padding, use only horizontal */
  justify-content: center; /* Center text vertically in the area */
  align-items: flex-start; /* Align text to the left */
  flex: 0 0 48px;
  box-sizing: border-box; /* Include padding in height calculation */
  overflow: hidden;
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / 80%);
  height: 52px;
  transition: background-color 1s ease;
}

.cards.highlights .cards-card-image {
  flex: 1; /* Take remaining space after text */
  width: 100%; /* Full width */
  overflow: hidden; /* Hide overflow */
  order: -1; /* Ensure image appears first (on top) */
}

.cards.highlights > ul > li img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%; /* Fill the image container */
  object-fit: contain;
  background-color: white;
  transition: transform 0.5s ease; /* Smooth zoom transition */
}

.cards.highlights > ul > li:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05); /* Slight zoom on hover */
}

/* Override general card body hover effect for highlights */
.cards.highlights > ul > li:hover .cards-card-body {
  background-color: var(--primary-color);
}

.cards.highlights h2 {
  color: white;
  font-size: 20px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: normal;
}

.cards.highlights a {
  color: white;
}

/* Add arrow icon for highlights */
.cards.highlights > ul > li::after {
  content: '›';

  right: 16px;
  bottom: 0; /* Start from bottom */

  align-items: center; /* Center arrow vertically within its container */
  font-size: 24px;
  color: white;
  font-weight: bold;
  line-height: 1; /* Remove line-height spacing */
}
```

```
/* eslint-disable import/prefer-default-export, no-use-before-define */
/**
 * Adobe PDF Viewer Component - Pure JS implementation
 * Uses Adobe PDF Embed API (DC View SDK)
 * Converted from React AdobePDFViewer.tsx
 */

// Module state
let adobeDCViewInstance = null;

// Adobe PDF Embed API – one client ID per allowed domain.
// NOTE: Adobe PDF Embed client IDs are domain-locked. Register a client ID for the
// Spark production host at https://developer.adobe.com/document-services/apis/pdf-embed/
// and replace the placeholder below before PDF preview works on production.
const CLIENT_IDS = {
  localhost: '5b30e43dabf0482480341b9395596694',
  'kirklandsmedia.com': 'REPLACE_WITH_FRESCOPA_PDF_EMBED_CLIENT_ID',
};

/**
 * Resolve the Adobe PDF Embed API client ID for the current host.
 * @returns {string}
 */
function getAdobeClientId() {
  const { hostname } = window.location;
  if (hostname === 'localhost') return CLIENT_IDS.localhost;
  const domain = Object.keys(CLIENT_IDS).find(
    (d) => d !== 'localhost' && (hostname === d || hostname.endsWith(`.${d}`)),
  );
  return domain ? CLIENT_IDS[domain] : CLIENT_IDS.localhost;
}

// Cached promise so concurrent callers share the same Adobe SDK load cycle.
let adobePdfScriptPromise = null;

/**
 * Load Adobe PDF Embed API script.
 * Returns a cached promise so concurrent callers share the same load cycle.
 * @returns {Promise<void>} Resolves when window.AdobeDC is available
 */
async function loadAdobePdfScript() {
  if (adobePdfScriptPromise) return adobePdfScriptPromise;

  adobePdfScriptPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (window.AdobeDC) {
      resolve();
      return;
    }

    /**
     * Poll for window.AdobeDC with a timeout.
     * @param {number} timeoutMs - Maximum time to wait
     */
    function waitForAdobeDC(timeoutMs) {
      let settled = false;
      const checkReady = setInterval(() => {
        if (window.AdobeDC && !settled) {
          settled = true;
          clearInterval(checkReady);
          resolve();
        }
      }, 100);

      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!settled) {
          settled = true;
          clearInterval(checkReady);
          if (window.AdobeDC) {
            resolve();
          } else {
            reject(new Error('Timeout waiting for Adobe PDF Embed API'));
          }
        }
      }, timeoutMs);
    }

    // Check if script tag is already in the DOM (e.g. added by another block)
    const existingScript = document.querySelector('script[src*="acrobatservices.adobe.com"]');
    if (existingScript) {
      waitForAdobeDC(10000);
      return;
    }

    const script = document.createElement('script');
    script.src = 'https://acrobatservices.adobe.com/view-sdk/viewer.js';
    script.async = true;
    script.onload = () => waitForAdobeDC(5000);
    script.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load Adobe PDF Embed API'));
    document.body.appendChild(script);
  });

  // If loading fails, clear the cached promise so a retry is possible
  adobePdfScriptPromise.catch(() => {
    adobePdfScriptPromise = null;
  });

  return adobePdfScriptPromise;
}

/**
 * Create Adobe PDF Viewer
 * @param {Object} options
 * @param {string} options.pdfUrl - URL of the PDF to display
 * @param {string} options.fileName - Name of the PDF file
 * @param {boolean} [options.showDownloadPDF=false] - Show download button
 * @param {boolean} [options.showPrintPDF=false] - Show print button
 * @param {number} [options.initialLoadDelayMs=0] - Delay before viewer initialization
 * @param {function(): void} [options.onClose] - Close handler
 * @returns {HTMLElement}
 */
export function createAdobePDFViewer(options) {
  const {
    pdfUrl,
    fileName,
    showDownloadPDF = false,
    showPrintPDF = false,
    initialLoadDelayMs = 0,
    onClose,
  } = options;

  // State
  let isLoading = true;
  let error = null;
  let isInFullscreen = false;

  // Create container
  const container = document.createElement('div');
  container.className = 'adobe-pdf-viewer-container';

  // Generate unique ID for the viewer div
  const viewerId = `adobe-dc-view-${Date.now()}`;

  /**
   * Handle fullscreen change
   */
  function handleFullscreenChange() {
    isInFullscreen = !!(
      document.fullscreenElement
      || document.webkitFullscreenElement
      || document.mozFullScreenElement
      || document.msFullscreenElement
    );

    // When exiting fullscreen, refocus to ensure keyboard events work
    if (!isInFullscreen) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        const viewerEl = container.querySelector('.adobe-pdf-viewer');
        if (viewerEl) viewerEl.focus();
      }, 100);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Handle escape key
   */
  function handleEscape(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && onClose) {
      // If in fullscreen, let browser handle ESC to exit fullscreen
      if (isInFullscreen) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      onClose();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Initialize Adobe viewer
   */
  async function initializeViewer() {
    try {
      // Optional startup delay for contexts where Adobe SDK/DOM races on first mount.
      if (initialLoadDelayMs > 0) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
          window.setTimeout(resolve, initialLoadDelayMs);
        });
      }
      // Uses pdfviewer's loader: injects script if needed and polls for window.AdobeDC
      await loadAdobePdfScript();

      if (!window.AdobeDC) {
        throw new Error('Adobe PDF viewer not available');
      }

      adobeDCViewInstance = new window.AdobeDC.View({
        clientId: getAdobeClientId(),
        divId: viewerId,
      });

      // Fetch the PDF ourselves using the browser's session cookie, then pass
      // the content to Adobe SDK via its promise-based mode. This ensures:
      // 1. The session cookie is included (worker auth middleware requires it)
      // 2. The rendition URL is preserved (web-optimized /as/ URLs don't serve raw PDFs)

      const pdfFetchUrl = pdfUrl.startsWith('http') ? pdfUrl : `${window.location.origin}${pdfUrl}`;
      const pdfPromise = fetch(pdfFetchUrl, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
        .then((resp) => {
          if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`Failed to fetch PDF: ${resp.status}`);
          return resp.arrayBuffer();
        });

      adobeDCViewInstance.previewFile(
        {
          content: { promise: pdfPromise },
          metaData: { fileName: fileName || 'document.pdf' },
        },
        {
          embedMode: 'SIZED_CONTAINER',
          showDownloadPDF,
          showPrintPDF,
          showLeftHandPanel: false,
        },
      );

      // Update loading state WITHOUT re-rendering the container via innerHTML,
      // which would destroy the Adobe SDK's render target div.
      isLoading = false;
      const loadingEl = container.querySelector('.adobe-pdf-loading');
      if (loadingEl) loadingEl.remove();
      const viewerEl = container.querySelector('.adobe-pdf-viewer');
      if (viewerEl) viewerEl.style.display = 'block';
```

```
/* header and nav layout */

@import url("./profile.css");

:root {
  --nav-bar-height: var(--nav-height);
}

header {
  font-family: var(--body-font-family);
}

/* Common Dropdown Menu Styles */
header .dropdown-menu {
  display: none;
}

header .dropdown-menu > ul {
  background-color: var(--color-neutral-50);
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
  font-size: 14px;
  list-style-type: none;
  margin: 0;
  min-width: 180px;
  padding: 8px;
}

/* Portaled dropdown overlay (appended to document.body to escape stacking contexts) */
.header-dropdown-portal {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: 10000;
}

.header-dropdown-portal > ul {
  background-color: var(--color-neutral-50);
  border-radius: 4px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 14px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);

}

header nav .dropdown-menu > ul > li,

}

  color: var(--primary-color);
}

/* My Account Dropdown Menu - Specific Styles */
header nav .my-account .my-account-menu > ul,
.header-dropdown-portal.my-account-portal > ul {
  min-width: 200px;
}

/* User Button (User Dropdown) */
header nav .my-account {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  position: relative;
}

header nav .my-account .my-account-button {
  align-items: center;
  background: var(--color-neutral-50);
  border: 1px solid var(--primary-color);
  border-radius: 60px;
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  font-family: var(--body-font-family);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 500;
  line-height: 140%;
  max-height: 40px;
  padding: 6px 16px 6px 6px;
}

header nav .my-account .avatar {
  background-color: var(--primary-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  font-family: var(--body-font-family);
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.84px;
  margin-right: 4px;
  padding: 4px;
  text-align: center;
  position: relative;
}

header nav .my-account .avatar .impersonation-indicator {
  position: absolute;
  top: -2px;
  right: -2px;
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  background-color: var(--primary-color);
  border: 2px solid var(--color-neutral-50);
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%);
}

header nav .my-account-button:hover {
  background: var(--primary-color);
}

header nav .my-account-button:hover .avatar {
  background-color: var(--color-neutral-50);
}

header nav .my-account-button.active {
  background: var(--primary-color);
}

header nav .my-account-button.active .avatar {
  background-color: var(--color-neutral-50);
}

/* Arrow Icons */
header nav .down-arrow-icon {
  display: flex;
}

header nav .down-arrow-icon::before {
  background: url("/icons/down-arrow-icon.svg") no-repeat 50%;
  content: "";
  display: inline-block;
  height: 20px;
  margin-left: 4px;
  width: 20px;
}

header nav .down-arrow-icon:hover::before {
  background: url("/icons/down-arrow-icon-red.svg") no-repeat 50%;
}

header .nav-wrapper {
  background-color: var(--color-neutral-50);
  color: var(--text-color);
  color-scheme: light;
  width: 100%;
  z-index: 2;
  box-shadow: 0 3px 5px var(--dark-color)0000D;
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
}

/* When hamburger menu is open, ensure nav overlay sits above page content (e.g. Training Resources card icons) */
header .nav-wrapper:has(nav[aria-expanded='true']) {
  z-index: 100;
}

header nav {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  display: grid;
  grid-template: 'hamburger brand tools' var(--nav-bar-height) / auto 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0 24px;
  margin: auto;
  height: var(--nav-bar-height);
  padding: 0 24px;
}

header nav:has(.nav-sections) {
  grid-template:
    'hamburger brand tools' var(--nav-bar-height) 'sections sections sections' 1fr / auto 1fr auto;
}

header nav:not(:has(.nav-sections)) {
  grid-template: 'brand tools' var(--nav-bar-height) / 1fr auto;
}

@media (width < 900px) {
  header nav:not(:has(.nav-sections)) .nav-hamburger {
    display: none !important;
  }

  header nav[aria-expanded='true'] .nav-sections {
    width: 320px;
    position: fixed;
    left: 0;
    top: var(--nav-bar-height);
    z-index: 2;
    height: calc(100dvh - var(--nav-bar-height));
    overflow-y: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    background-color: var(--color-neutral-50);
    box-shadow: 8px 0 24px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 30%);
    border-top: 1px solid #ededed;
  }
}

@media (width >=900px) {
  header nav {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0 48px;
```

```
/* Cart Panel Styles - Full workflow cart panel */

/* Converted from React CartDownloads components */

/* ==========================================================================
   Base Panel Overlay & Modal Styles
   ========================================================================== */

.base-panel-overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background-color: rgb(0 0 0 / 50%);
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: flex-start;
  z-index: 1200;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 40px 20px;
}

.base-panel-overlay :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)::after {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Prevent body scroll when panel is open */
body.base-panel-open,
body.cart-panel-open,
body.download-panel-open {
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

html.base-panel-open {
  overflow: hidden !important;
}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel {
  min-width: 1000px;
  max-width: 1280px;
  width: 1000px;
  background-color: white;
  border-radius: 16px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgb(0 0 0 / 15%);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  animation: fade-in 0.3s ease-out;
  padding: 35px;
}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel.cart-panel {
  width: 90%;
  max-width: 60%;
  min-width: auto;
  height: 80vh;
  max-height: 90vh;
  align-self: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}

@keyframes fade-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.95);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .base-panel-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;

}

  border: none;

  font-size: 20px;

  padding: 4px;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: flex-end;
  border-radius: 4px;
  color: var(--color-neutral-700);
  margin: 0;
}

  background: none;

}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .header-actions {
  display: flex;

  gap: 8px;
}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .header-icon-btn {
  border: none;

  margin: 0;
  display: flex;

}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .header-icon-btn:hover {
  background: none;

  width: 32px;

}

/* ==========================================================================
   Panel Tabs

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .base-panel-tabs {
  display: flex;

  padding: 0;

  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--primary-color);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .base-panel-tabs .base-panel-tab {
  padding: 12px 32px;

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .base-panel-tabs .base-panel-tab.active {

.base-panel-overlay .base-panel .base-panel-tabs .base-panel-tab.active::after {
  content: '';
```

```
/* ========================================
```
```
   CSS Variables & Theme (inherits global semantic tokens)
   ======================================== */

:root {
  /* Primary colors — align with global :root */
  --primary-color-hover: var(--primary-color-hover);
  --primary-color-active: #1A1A1A;
  --primary-color-disabled: var(--color-neutral-300, #D9D8D4);

  /* Color scales (Light mode) */
  --gray-50: var(--color-neutral-50);
  --gray-100: var(--color-neutral-100);
  --gray-200: var(--color-neutral-300);
  --gray-300: var(--color-neutral-400);
  --gray-400: var(--color-neutral-600);
  --gray-500: var(--color-neutral-700);
  --purple-100: rgb(0 37 61 / 12%);
  --purple-200: rgb(0 37 61 / 20%);
  --purple-300: rgb(0 37 61 / 30%);
  --purple-400: var(--primary-color);
  --purple-500: var(--primary-color-hover);
  --purple-600: #1A1A1A;
  --red-100: rgb(191 164 135 / 16%);
  --red-200: rgb(191 164 135 / 28%);
  --red-300: var(--color-red);
  --red-400: var(--color-red);
  --red-500: var(--secondary-color);
  --red-600: var(--color-dark-red);
  --highlight-hover: rgb(0 0 0 / 7%);
  --highlight-pressed: rgb(0 0 0 / 15%);

  /* Semantic colors */
  --focus-ring-color: var(--primary-color);
  --text-color-base: var(--color-neutral-600, #828081);
  --text-color-hover: var(--text-color);
  --text-color-disabled: var(--gray-200);

  --border-color: var(--color-neutral-400, #C2C0BA);
  --border-color-hover: var(--color-neutral-600, #828081);
  --border-color-pressed: var(--color-neutral-700, #5E5C5D);
  --border-color-disabled: var(--gray-100);
  --field-background: var(--gray-50);
  --field-text-color: var(--text-color);
  --overlay-background: var(--gray-50);
  --button-background: var(--gray-50);
  --button-background-pressed: var(--light-color);
  --highlight-background: var(--primary-color);
  --highlight-background-pressed: var(--primary-color-hover);
  --highlight-background-invalid: var(--color-red);
  --highlight-foreground: white;
  --highlight-foreground-pressed: var(--light-color);
  --highlight-overlay: rgb(0 37 61 / 15%);
  --invalid-color: var(--color-red);
  --invalid-color-pressed: var(--color-dark-red);
}

/* Dark mode */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root {
    --background-color: #1F1C1D;

}
```
